name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: A set of mutually-exclusive options — single selection, arrow-key navigation, and a 24px invisible hit area (A11Y-2). Built on Base UI Radio Group.

meta.whenToUse: A form value from 2–5 mutually-exclusive choices, all visible at once.
meta.whenNotToUse: An immediate view or scope switch over the same content (ToggleGroup), many options (Select), or non-exclusive multi-select (Checkboxes).
